about: Pre-rendered narrator clips (Kokoro-82M, Apache-2.0, via kokoro-js). Made by tools/voice-gen.js (npm run voices); do not edit.

00da7f0ebc950154.t: Members of the house, take your seats!

0151151d52d17b76.t: Fast pays. 300 points at the first note, ticking down to 100 at the buzzer.

03cf1a4647114225.t: Grab a pencil! It's JustSketch Relay. Draw it, guess it, pass it on!

04a201c6919d057f.t: Type a funny fact! Bonus points for embarrassing!

07506f150961f79d.t: Shhh… let’s play Who Said It!

079ae7c2a6fb3c1e.t: Phones together, steady hands, and roll it home!

079d4524ce72fac8.t: The prompt. A prompt goes up: Who’s most likely to… survive a zombie apocalypse? Think about everyone in the room.

07b1f08e2b60f456.t: Read a Friend. Every 3rd round, one player places themselves and everyone guesses where. Closest: 300, 200, 100, +150 for a bullseye.. Drag to where you think they stand, then lock it in.

08f467555db06b89.t: Scoring. Clear the maze and everyone scores, more with time to spare. +30 for a pass that gets closer, +25 per , +50 for sinking it, −15 per hole.

091b5d915c84d4fb.t: Flashlight. Pay 5% of your cash (at least $25) for a private hint about what’s hidden inside.. Tap Flashlight peek for a secret hint.

0d1d5b822526bb7b.t: Most points wins. And at the end, we open the files on the best lies of the night.

0d86dfc605486436.t: Shout it out. Shouting works too: the actor taps They got it! and picks who said it first.. Actor: tap They got it! then tap the guesser’s name.

0ed501a797c20550.t: Good evening, darlings, and welcome to the Most Likely To awards! I'm Velvet Vance!

103f11c7e0b51a0a.t: Hoo-hoo! At the end you meet your twin tonight, and your opposite. Go say hi!

10a351d997137a84.t: Funniest video. At the end everyone votes for the funniest video. The best-of reel replays the winners from their biggest laugh.. Tap the funniest video to vote.

113628246541abc9.t: The Lantern. Tap ONLY when the lantern on the TV turns GREEN. Every decoy colour you tap is a false start.. Eyes on the TV, thumb on the pad.

1183529ccea80d94.t: Plot twists. Silent movie · Sound effects only · Act it as… a style · Freeze frame (one pose per buzz) · Relay · Two-person scene (two prompts, guess both).

11a1946f4787b538.t: The President scores four, the Scum scores nothing. The last round counts double, and the most points wins the realm!

121f7addd3d900b7.t: Bet on it. How sure are you? 1× Hunch, 2× Sure or 3× HOT TAKE.. Tap 1×, 2× or 3×, then tap your answer.

141dbe22ee1c0f91.t: The royal trade. Finishing order gives titles, President down to Scum. Next deal the Scum must hand the President their best cards!. President? Tap the cards to give back, then tap Give.

143645f5d804e843.t: Howdy, folks, and welcome to JustBid! I'm Rusty Rattlebang, fastest gavel in the West!

14f1d4cda98df996.t: Meet the crew. Every one of them swears they’re human.

150cecd07a704f5e.t: Hints & winning. Stuck? Hints show the words, then the first letters. The last round counts DOUBLE. Most points wins!

16277e513ccfd8da.t: The request line is open. Send me your songs!

1c03dbb9378dfef0.t: Line it up. Pick your video early! It plays the moment your turn comes, and ready videos never wait for a slow picker.

1d2206025a5820ea.t: Items. Items help: a makes fights safer, a helps you climb, a cures a bite. Bullets run out!. Tap Give an item to a survivor to help a friend.

1e175a3f8e6b2caa.t: Choose. The TV shows what’s happening. Pick an option, then watch what happens to everyone who picked it.. Tap one of the options before time runs out. Freezing is risky!

1e404984ef8da796.t: Rate it. After each song, rate how hard it was: 1 Too easy to 5 Impossible. Guessers’ points are multiplied by the average.. Tap 1 to 5.

1f8d12a4e3e59340.t: Six kinds of module. Fuse Lines, the Plunger, the Glyph Pad, the Tunnel Map, the Combination Dial and Signal Lamps. Make every module safe to defuse the bomb.. Defuser: tap a module’s tab, then cut, tap, hold, press or steer.

1fa64ec0caf5524a.t: Good evening, night owls! You’re tuned to Tune Buzz FM, and I’m DJ Wavelength!

218c4dab1a3d062c.t: Hear ye! Be the first to empty thy hand, and the crown is thine!

22d282bb4702c6d4.t: Hear ye, hear ye! The royal court of President is now in session!

23a572d5e5b6b160.t: Place your bet. Before every hand, bet some of your chips before the timer runs out.. Tap chips to stack your bet, then tap Bet.

242a303e9b412b2f.t: Twists & finale. Some hands get a twist: Happy Hour, Five-Card Charlie, Ties Win or Lucky 21. The last hand pays DOUBLE. Broke? Free comeback chips!

25caf76e27263c79.t: Watch closely! A colour appears for three seconds, sometimes as an apple, a car or a sky. Then, poof, it is gone!

25ec3d60fd2c878e.t: Alliteration. Two or more words starting with the letter score 2, like Big Blue Banana. Five scoring answers in a row: +1.

2733ecdbf06400d8.t: The report. The TV shows HOW MANY sabotages hit, never who. No sabotage = a clean repair and a jump home. Each sabotage costs the system a bar; at zero it breaks.. Your notes show who worked beside you. The Engineer sees every station’s count.

2754280d35fa6100.t: Step right up! First, pick where to drop your ball along the top of the board.

27a8a4926720a727.t: Work it out together. Nobody can see the whole maze alone. Talk! The TV only uncovers the maze where the marble has been.

29ee78b2a8199fdd.t: Twists. Swap Sides: mid-debate, argue the opposite! Lawyer Mode: defend an object accused of a crime. Hot Takes: 20 seconds each. Team Debates in big rooms.

2b63fac6c243e417.t: Welcome to Hot Take Trivia! I’m Blaze Bixby. Know it? Then bet on it!

32275be6af0342f3.t: The motion is on the table. Let the debate begin!

3463d3591864ebf3.t: By sundown, Maple Heights had a new population.

35c83ce09fafaa11.t: Line bonuses. Your line pays you too: 20% of any good slot a ball you touched lands in, +50 for every rival you bust.

384aee7159ada78b.t: Find your spot. Place yourself where YOU stand. Nobody sees it until the reveal.. Drag the marker (or tap ◀ ▶), then tap Lock it in .

38522952321af330.t: Heckle (nicely). Audience: react live. push the crowd meter toward the speaker, pulls it back. Send in a question; the room votes which one gets asked.. Tap . Type a question and tap Send.

389e20baff55304a.t: Phones out. Let’s turn up the heat!

396644cbd03dc7e2.t: The question. A question goes up on the big screen. Everyone answers in secret: nobody sees whose answer is whose.. Type your answer, then tap Whisper it .

3a8a2e9d50c81f04.t: The title. The winner is crowned with a new TITLE: fame, not points. Ties share the crown!

3c02fce066f64bc2.t: Fix the ship. Trust no one. And whatever you do, don’t get abducted.

3c1b4e4a1eb50d5e.t: Write fast. Write one answer per category that starts with that letter, before time runs out.. Type an answer in each box. Enter jumps to the next one.

3c99767d081438d1.t: Pass it on. Roll it through a gap at the edge (the little yellow arrows) and it lands on your neighbour’s phone.. Yellow arrows at the edge of your board are gaps to your neighbours.

3f3bbfbb44d03e21.t: Take your time. I'll just stand here… looking fabulous.

4039d3101824d9ed.t: Tilt to roll. The marble starts on one phone. Whoever has it tilts their phone to roll it around the walls.. When the marble is on your phone, tilt it gently. No tilt sensor? Drag your finger on the board.

42c813d9f9c957b3.t: Howdy, partners! Welcome to Quick Draw, where the fastest thumb in the West takes it all!

431d44b6864f24ad.t: I once auctioned off my own shadow. The buyer still follows me everywhere!

44d5f1b0e17cb452.t: The reading. Answers are read out one by one with no names, so nobody knows whose is whose. Once a game you can swap your whole hand.. New hand swaps all your cards (once a game).

466f5f5d25b8bff1.t: Hot Seat. Midway, one player answers for double points while everyone else bets on whether they’ll get it right.. Not in the seat? Tap RIGHT or WRONG.

473123b3da4141d6.t: The crowd decides. Vote for the winner, then pick the best line. Debaters score their vote share (up to 1000) +200 for the win, up to +300 crowd meter, +250 best line. Back the winner: +100.. Tap a side, then tap the speech with the best line.

4770933ccc5b74ce.t: Draw it. Everyone gets a secret prompt and draws it on their phone.. Draw with your finger, then tap Done . ( New prompt swaps it.)

4784532552884131.t: The sweet spot. Your song: some (not all) got it = 150 × difficulty. Everyone got it = 50 ×. Nobody = 0. Pick fun-hard, not impossible!

480ada37f7b7ac89.t: Good evening, and welcome to Price Panic! I'm your host, Sterling Sparks!

48ad46b97cb86e1e.t: Draw the guess. The next player sees only that guess and draws it… and so on around the circle. Things get weird fast!. Draw the words you see, then tap Done .

48b8b2c0a8934015.t: Rate & react. While it plays, rate how funny it is and spam reactions. They float up the TV and fill the laugh meter.. Tap to to rate, and tap reactions as much as you like.

4a1a4ed957a40190.t: The reveal. Everyone’s dots slide onto one line. +50 if you’re within 10 of the room average, +25 for the closest pair.. Waiting? Guess where the room average lands: +75 if you’re close.

4af2563fd4ea42e2.t: Match %. Your mix appears next to the real colour with a % match. Closer means more points, up to 1000.

4b4ab36a303aab07.t: Bust Bets. Think a friend will go over 21? Bet 25 chips on it. If they bust, you get 75!. Under Bust Bet, tap a friend’s name (or Nobody).

4d94fc01b71e205e.t: Pencils ready… let’s play Letter Rush!

4e52837dff85318c.t: Fix the ship. Each shift a system breaks: Oxygen, Engines or Shields. Everyone picks a repair station. Aliens can sabotage instead of fixing.. Tap a station. Aliens get Fix and Sabotage buttons.

4f9f1523a48ba670.t: Here's who's at my table tonight!

516f013217eb6fef.t: Round types. Free Caption, Same Template, Prompted situations, and Remix, where you finish someone else’s half-made meme.

53f095b69ae952c2.t: Smash their fortress. Troops that reach the far wall damage its keeps. Knock down every enemy keep to win, or hold the front line deepest in their land when time runs out. Last 90 seconds: FINAL CHARGE!. Your keep’s health is on your phone. It buzzes when it’s hit!

565d1fe659a32474.t: Everyone else: the manual. Experts get DIFFERENT pages of the field manual. Each module’s rules are split between two experts, so the whole room has to talk.. Expert? Flip through your pages, and ask the defuser what they see.

56a36795e0b31a3c.t: Order! Order! Welcome to Debate Club, the most argumentative room in town. I’m Judge Penelope Gavel.

580778b8904c314f.t: Bravo!. After every scene, applaud the best performance: each is +25 for the actor. The awards night crowns the Oscar-worthy and the Mime Master!. Tap on the actor you loved.

58b1fc7b847692df.t: Invest for later. You earn 10 gold a second. Every summon adds a little to YOUR income for the rest of the battle, and Gold Mines add +3 a second. Defend now, or invest to win later?. Gold Mine is under the troops.

594948ad145dd6f7.t: Disposal unit, we have a call-out. A crate of very silly bombs just turned up at the town fair.

5b3da5c36ec73e17.t: Don't be shy! Every fact's a bargain!

5bb61a8b29b82e5b.t: Your move. Hit for another card, Stand to stop. Double doubles your bet for one last card. Split turns a pair into two hands.. Tap Hit, Stand, Double or Split.

5ecca3ee142911ef.t: Prep with argument cards. 30 seconds to plan. Your phone deals 3 argument cards (Made-Up Statistic, Dramatic Pause…). Tap one during your speech and it pops up on the TV.. Tap I’m ready , then tap a card mid-speech.

606b3bad1bd129e9.t: Scoring. The first right guess and the actor both score 100 + up to 100 for speed. A twist scene gives the actor +50. The final scene counts double!

61f4a3c094b20cfb.t: Hiya! I'm Winky, and welcome to Emoji Charades, where words are BANNED!

6457dc3ff03a0cbd.t: Ghosts & the beam. Ejected players become ghosts: they patch systems (2 patches = +1 bar) and whisper suspects to the TV. A lone alien gets one abduction beam!. Ghosts: tap a system to patch, then a name to whisper.

661268c6dcd23fb3.t: Two kingdoms. One battlefield. And a front line that only one of them will hold.

6806c485e95aa502.t: Level up your team. Spending earns team XP. Tier 2 unlocks Mages, Knights, Catapults and Healers (and Meteor); Tier 3 unlocks Giants, Dragons and Ballistas. Rally Horn boosts your whole army.. Locked troops show and their tier.

68da696401302d58.t: The speeches. Opening statements (45 s each), rebuttals, one question from the audience, then a typed closing line you read out loud. Done early? Pass the mic.. Speaking? Tap I’m done to pass the mic.

6efb5a6d62b9a009.t: Welcome to the workshop! I carved you a maze, and every one of you holds a piece of it!

72322507cefae6f4.t: Your turn. Everyone takes turns putting a funny video on the big screen: YouTube, Shorts, TikTok or Instagram Reels.. Search with or paste a link, then tap Use it.

733186e046ac232d.t: Scoring. Vote for the funniest entry: 100 points a vote. If a book’s last guess still matches the prompt, everyone on it gets +50!. Tap the funniest entry to vote.

73cb171ba54a5e39.t: One letter. One list. Every answer has to start with it.

764559c3777fd4e8.t: Challenge. Something fishy? Challenge an answer and the room votes on whether it counts.. Tap to challenge. Then vote Counts or Nope.

764cb9d67ec3ee04.t: The hot seat. One by one, each suspect’s three statements go up on the big screen, shuffled.

768d8703223e5f9c.t: Shopping Spree. The last round shows three items. Guess the TOTAL: it’s worth double points. Highest score wins!

77a368edd14b6a15.t: Scoring. Right guess: +100, and +50 more if you were one of the fastest. Three right in a row: +50.

7b3382c8587e3218.t: Double Down. Once a game, Double Down: double points if you’re right, −50 if you’re wrong. Most points wins!. Tap Double Down, then tap a name.

7b43abcdfc3e7863.t: Do I hear a fun fact? Anybody? Going once…

7ba816a8348cc3f0.t: Predict. Then guess who the ROOM will pick. +100 if your vote matches the winner, +150 for a correct prediction.. Tap who you think will win (or Skip prediction).

7c871dc9a1908eb6.t: The Judge. The Judge crowns the funniest card (in big groups everyone votes). Not judging? Send a to your favourite.. Judge? Tap the funniest, then tap Crown the winner.

7d17694cd1d012e1.t: But something slipped aboard. Something… gooey.

7f1e4fb9777dcd3c.t: It gets harder. Every bomb has more modules and less time. From bomb 3 the Radio asks for a callsign: answer it within 25 seconds. Big groups split into squads.

8171b9de4ddb67d2.t: Evening, high rollers! You all play against me at once. Beat my hand, and the most chips at the end wins.

82060d46b46c2318.t: The question. A question and four answers go up on the TV. Be quick: the clock is ticking!

8271718c42c616bd.t: Meme of the Night. The night ends with a Meme of the Night showdown, awards and a gallery you can download.

84779dbd52a14277.t: Scoring. +100 for every scene you survive, +500 if you make the rescue. Ghosts score by calling it. The longest survivor wins!

8496e9e9fd6716b7.t: Interrogate. Grill the suspect out loud. Ask questions, watch them sweat. Then everyone votes for the lie.. Tap the statement you think is the lie.

850fc45e881d3279.t: Sets & loans. Collect 3 items from the same set for a bonus. Broke? Take a bank loan (2 max), repaid with 20% interest.. Tap My collection to see your sets, or Loan for cash.

8747a36af91868a7.t: Only a few made it to the safehouse.

8786622a44cac61c.t: Beat the pile. Play a single, pair, triple or four of a kind. The next player must beat it with the same number of cards.. Tap a set to play it, or tap your cards, then tap Play.

878f327e63f3ca22.t: Ladies and gentlemen, please take your seats. The show is about to begin!

891f01c6cb5c21e7.t: The letter. A letter is rolled and a list of categories goes up on the big screen.

8ad1de03ce3039bc.t: Special rounds. Watch for Blink (1 second!), Two-Tone, Name It, Halfway There and Odd One Out.. Odd One Out: tap the tile that looks different, fast!

8ad8f53213cd1d5b.t: And a hearty howdy to everyone else!

8b66992fa32dbfed.t: Skip it. Not funny? Vote to skip. Enough skips and the next video starts.. Tap ⏭ Boring! Skip it.

8c1a6775d669492f.t: Mix it. Mix the colour from memory. No peeking!. Drag the hue bar, then the brightness pad. Tap Lock it in.

8d187cb1d617cdd7.t: One of you sees the bomb. The rest of you read the manual. Talk fast, and cut carefully.

8ef943f1c4e160ef.t: Let's find out where you stand!

8f356eb261233c94.t: The reveal. The TV replays every book, entry by entry, from the first prompt to the final guess.

8f3df405ef60b4ff.t: Talk, then vote. Talk it out, then vote someone into the bubble pod, or skip. A tie ejects nobody. The pod announces if they were an alien.. Post claims ( I was at…, I suspect…), then tap a name or ⏭ Skip vote.

9140c14c4c5c9341.t: Two armies, one front line. Sunrise vs Nightfall. Your troops march on their own and fight whatever they meet. The flag in the middle is the FRONT LINE.. Check your team at the top of your phone.

91ba91c7b047b4a8.t: Stay together. Grab what you can. And whatever you do… don’t get bitten.

926dc148477259d8.t: Guess the price. A product goes up on the big screen. How much does it cost?. Slide or tap to set your guess (or ⌨ Type an exact price), then tap Lock in.

9279b33970b38e56.t: Summon troops with gold. Tap a troop to summon it: Spearmen cost 50, Archers 60, Riders 80, Shieldwalls 70. Each troop type has a short cooldown (the ring on its button).. Tap a troop button. Grey = not enough gold yet.

94bc2fa87d284f81.t: Play a card. Pick the answer that fits best. Some prompts need two cards. Blank cards let you write your own.. Tap your funniest card, then tap Play it!

97a438fc13b40353.t: Guess it. Everyone else types guesses on their phone. Typos, plurals and synonyms count, and means you’re close! Guesses show blurred on the TV until one is right.. Type a guess and tap Guess! as often as you like.

988f723c2a611d1d.t: Winning. Each round the board gets harder, and old lines stay as ghosts. Most money wins!

9a06a3ccb1ea7e72.t: Bitten? Fallen?. Bitten? Find a medkit by the end of the next scene or you turn. Fall and you become a ghost.. Ghost? Bless or curse a survivor each scene.

9bfb847afa7a5258.t: Phones out! Let's play Emoji Charades!

9f275ec0c6dccf18.t: Contestants, tell me somethin' funny about yourselves!

a108bd0368aef9c0.t: Winning. Most points wins! Plus awards like Big Better, Coward, Comeback Kid and Speed Demon.

a1ffc44c2cf1ad8a.t: Pass it on. Your book passes around the circle. The next player sees only your drawing and guesses what it is.. Type what you think it is, then tap Send guess .

a21a006bd5b49169.t: Power-ups. Once each per game: Double Down (×2), Bust Shield (no halving) and Peek at the room’s average.. Tap a power-up before you lock in.

a220e1a191ae7cab.t: Guess it. Everyone else races to type the answer. Guess as often as you like: small typos are fine!. Type your guess and tap Send .

a27de5b97cbb9bd5.t: Psst… everybody here has a secret. Answer in a whisper, then guess who said what.

a2f9cc756ec26ad1.t: Welcome to JustBlanks! Fill in the blank, and the funniest card wins!

a49ee3a4551d5374.t: Eyes open, brushes ready. Let’s play Color Match!

a5ee0a049eec9b9a.t: All In. The final question: see the category, bet any share of your points, then answer.. Tap how much to bet (up to ALL IN), then your answer.

a6bd22779731b7b9.t: Card values. Face cards are 10, Aces are 1 or 11. Blackjack (an Ace and a 10-card) pays 3 to 2. The dealer draws to 17.

a840ee76f00b8c4d.t: Drop!. Every ball drops at once. Slots pay money, ×2 doubles your round, STEAL robs the leader and BUST costs you.

a89b4c2fcba2f654.t: The prompt. A prompt card with a blank goes up on the big screen. Fill it in with the funniest card in your hand!

aa62f5488925d1b8.t: Each round a bomb arrives. Only the defuser can see it, on their phone. Nobody else can.

aca4b3b7870645cd.t: Card order. 3 is the lowest card, then up through King and Ace. 2 is the highest, and a 2 clears the pile so you lead again.

ace74283832dfc52.t: Copycat. Listen to the drum on the TV, then tap the same rhythm back. Two rhythms, each one longer.. Tap the pad in time when it says YOUR TURN.

ae73a610107829a4.t: This is an emergency broadcast. Stay indoors. Do not approach the… the… oh no.

ae9bdbdb5ec245d0.t: Don’t go over!. The closer you are, the more points, up to 1000. Go OVER the real price and your points are cut in half!

ae9ec94d92672564.t: And a big hand for everyone else!

af7120fe052e62f7.t: The spotlight. Answers go into the spotlight one at a time. Guess who wrote each one.. Tap the name of who you think said it.

b057573142c84eb2.t: Lights down, phones out! Welcome to JustFunny, the watch party!

b0cb8cea811052c8.t: Bonus rounds. Double Trouble: pick two people. Hot Seat: would they actually do it? The final prompt counts double!. Hot Seat: tap YES or NO. Double Trouble: tap two, then Lock in the duo.

b257d41a4cf6a451.t: Contestants, tell me something funny about yourselves!

b38d1a4eb86158e3.t: They’re ticking. They’re wired. And the only manual got torn into pieces.

b4d0a0cb4f2d5857.t: Stuck?. Tap an idea for inspiration, or swap your template once a round.. Tap New template to swap.

b5d2e270a1b7f802.t: Every phone shows one piece of a wooden maze. Put your phones together, just like the map on the TV!

b645a72197f76d72.t: Hoo-hoo! Welcome to Where Do You Stand? I'm Ollie. Morning person or night owl? I know where I stand!

b731d4d9291f400c.t: Hands by your phones… and DRAW!

b744687ed8aaa787.t: Phones out, partners! Type it in!

b92c6d907d987347.t: Stampede. Shake your phone to gallop your horse to the finish line. No motion sensor? Mash the pad instead.. Tap Allow shaking if asked, then SHAKE!

b96d96b2382df793.t: Pick your spot, draw your line, and let it DROP!

bd23cf08b11d6c19.t: Phones out! The audience is dying to know you!

be441c15efb18959.t: The spectrum. A spectrum goes up on the big screen, like Morning person ↔ Night owl . No wrong answers!

c0c8bf18d2af84d7.t: Vote. Vote for the player who fits it best. Votes are secret!. Tap a player’s name to vote.

c206820afbd19aa4.t: Deep space. The starship Biscuit is finally heading home.

c5627e03976039b8.t: At first light, the summoning circles awaken.

c5a2091debb92f8f.t: Howdy, partners! First up, the duel. Wait for the signal, then tap first. Tap too early, and that is a false start!

c7820cbcac079425.t: Scoring. The room shares one team score. You earn +150 for each module you solve, +100 for holding the right page, and +200 for every bomb your squad defuses.

c809947da0100147.t: Pass or rebel. Can’t beat it? You pass automatically. Four of a kind starts a REVOLUTION: low cards beat high ones until the next deal.. Nothing beats the pile? Your phone passes for you.

c9b78e0178a62e24.t: Combos. A perfect match (96% or more) builds a combo bonus. The last round is worth double. Most points wins!

cbc3bec0512d8ee8.t: Scoring. Right: 100 × your bet, plus up to 50 for speed. Wrong: lose 50 × your bet. Three right in a row: streak bonus!

ceca33c0e6e96e91.t: Ladies and gentlemen, step right up to JustDrop! Where every bounce is a gamble!

d0f8826470577dab.t: Winning. Every challenge pays by rank: 500 for 1st, down to 100. Podium streaks add a bonus, and the Final Showdown pays double!

d29a5322ba85710e.t: Draw one line. See where everyone is dropping, then draw ONE line to steer balls: yours to the jackpot, a rival’s into a bust.. Draw with your finger (2 strokes max), then tap Done!

d2d21008153a22ea.t: How to win. Crew: make the clean jumps home (4 on a Standard trip, 2 spare shifts) or catch every alien. Aliens: break a system, match the crew’s numbers, or run out the fuel.

d3c1434ae04308e9.t: Specials & winning. Watch for Sealed Bid, Mystery, Premium and the Grand Locker finale. Highest net worth (cash plus items) wins!. Sealed Bid? Type one secret bid and tap Seal it .

d513dc459862551f.t: Let's play JustBid! Bidding is OPEN!

d6fb28bba1c1314f.t: Each scene, one actor gets a secret prompt on their phone, and acts it out for the room.

d89dbdca693dc0c8.t: Chicken Run. Count the chickens crossing Main Street. Ducks, turkeys and rabbits don’t count!. Tap +1 for every , fix it with −1, then Lock in.

d8c838c7815b104c.t: Poker face. When it’s your answer, don’t give yourself away! You get +50 for everyone you fool.

d9b5168f7c164e33.t: Every suspect files three statements. Two are true. One is a lie. Make it a good one.

da4629c5906715e7.t: Strikes and BOOM. A wrong move is a strike and burns 15 seconds off the clock. Three strikes, or the timer hits 0:00, and it goes KA-BLAM!. Your strikes show as at the top of the screen.

db35544eba080465.t: Winning. The winning card earns a point. First to the target score wins, with awards and the best lines of the night!

dbc5b31549222a3b.t: And a big hand for everyone else!

dbd9a40f5d2f1a46.t: Bonjour, colour lovers! I am Hugo Hue. I show you a colour, you remember it, you mix it. Simple? Ha! We shall see.

de0b9a67d2d601d8.t: A locker rolls in with the door half up. Three peeks inside, partner, but them clues can lie!

de163cf2813666ea.t: The Clue Giver. Each round a Clue Giver secretly picks a movie, animal, food, place or saying from three choices.. Clue Giver? Tap one of the three answers.

df48e1f4e229299e.t: Secret roles. Most of you are crew. A few are secret aliens who know each other. Special crew: the Scanner and Engineer. The Mimic is an alien who fools the Scanner.. Tap the folder to see your role. Tap any time to peek again.

df5de416d9a0bcbe.t: Special rounds. Watch for Speed rounds, Theme rounds and the final Double Letter round: two letters, double points. Most points wins!

dff786b3afaf8a9f.t: Teamwork. Some choices need the group: the door only holds if enough people hold it, and one decoy keeps everyone else safer.

e2f3932098cd6be3.t: Vote. The TV parades every meme, then everyone votes for the funniest: 100 points a vote. No voting for your own!. Tap the funniest meme to vote.

e57e7ade8a7f7f7f.t: Pick the tricky bit. You hear the preview and choose which few seconds the room hears first. Skip the obvious part!. Slide to pick where the clip starts.

e8423e02335bd8b1.t: This is an emergency broadcast. Survive six days until the rescue arrives. Every scene, you make a choice.

e87dfde21139dcfb.t: No pressure… but everyone is watching!

e8944b1055780c40.t: Power-ups. Star pegs and slots give power-ups: Sticky Ball, Mega Ball, Twin Drop, Eraser and Ink Refill.. Got a power-up? Tap it before you lock in your drop.

e8cb01dbdbe240be.t: Bid live. Everyone bids at the same time. Every new bid restarts Going once… going twice… SOLD!. Tap +$10, +$25, +$100 or +$500 (or type an amount), then tap Bid.

ea5a6461c2671d57.t: Bonuses. Within 5% without going over: Bullseye, +500. The exact price: Jackpot, +1000! Three close rounds in a row: Hot Streak, +300.

eadff053fec2ba9d.t: Three statements. One lie. And somebody in this room is a very good liar.

eb6fc2bfc73c585a.t: Unpacking. The winner’s locker is unpacked item by item, from Junk to LEGENDARY. Profit or loss?

ebe069d6707d25b2.t: Holes and twists. Holes send the marble back to where it came onto your board. Each maze has a twist: ice, a backwards board, gems everywhere…

ebe6e932d24b9205.t: Contestants, tell me something funny about yourselves!

edaf4c62d465de15.t: Your template. Every round your phone gets a meme template. Write the captions and watch it come together live.. Type the top and bottom text, then tap Post it!

edc01141d6d2d658.t: Counters decide fights. Spearmen beat Riders, Riders beat Archers, Archers beat Spearmen. Shieldwalls shrug off arrows; Mages melt armour. A counter hits ×1.75: SUPER EFFECTIVE!. shows what a troop beats, what beats it. Tap Who beats who?

edf02b5777771895.t: Prices are so high tonight, my suit had to take out a loan!

f05c3451c422ac26.t: Be unique. Unique answers score 1. If anyone else wrote the same answer, it scores 0. Think different!

f2bccc7e2fb6cd16.t: Two debaters, one silly topic. Each debate, two players step up to the podiums with a topic and a side: Is cereal a soup? You say YES. Everyone else is the audience.. Debaters: your side shows in big letters.

f2db379193e0ffad.t: Emojis only. They spell it out using ONLY emojis. Each one pops up on the big screen.. Tap emojis to add them. ⌫ Undo takes one back, │ New word starts the next word.

f3a4706fc09301ad.t: Phones out, people! The audience is dying to know you!

f4261f5103c2f13d.t: Here's everyone on the scale tonight!

f48b70b543490b9d.t: Scoring. Spot the lie: +1 point. In the hot seat: +1 for every person you fool, up to 5 a turn.

f974a87ee1c270ef.t: Scoring. The first right answer scores 500, then less. Fewer emojis means bigger points. The Clue Giver scores when people get it.

face322ccf1069a0.t: Quick rounds. Higher or Lower? and Which Costs More? are fast-tap rounds. Be right AND quick for a speed bonus.. Tap or , or tap the pricier item.

fc8d568b28f6a3ff.t: Tonight’s callers are on the line!

fd6ae0289f2508bc.t: Good evening, high rollers! Welcome to Blackjack Night. The table is open!

fee225611c56c61f.t: Name that tune. The TV plays the clip. Each listen is longer. Type the title: typos are fine. You sit out your own songs.. Type the title. The artist too = +50.

fef59cc4a14d8b83.t: Bring your songs. Everyone adds songs from their phone. Search for anything, or paste a Spotify link.. Search, tap a song, done.

ff6120c21e1ff380.t: Our budget is so tiny, the confetti is just my old homework!
